name: obsidian-hugo-sync-modal
description: Obsidian plugin to publish and sync notes to any Hugo static site on GitHub

scripts.package: npm run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const archiver = require('child_process'); archiver.execSync('powershell Compress-Archive -Path main.js,manifest.json,styles.css -DestinationPath obsidian-hugo-sync-modal.zip -Force'); console.log('Package created: obsidian-hugo-sync-modal.zip');"

author: Dr. Rubanbalaji
